    return preds


def paired_bootstrap(preds_a, preds_b, n_boot=10000, seed=42):
    ids = sorted(set(preds_a.keys()) & set(preds_b.keys()))
    n = len(ids)
    correct_a = np.array([1 if preds_a[i][0] == preds_a[i][1] else 0 for i in ids])
